lyrics:
[00:12.41]I'm going back to 505
[00:16.61]If it's a seven hour flight or a forty-five minute drive
[00:23.89]In my imagination, you're waiting, lying on your side
[00:30.40]With your hands between your thighs
[00:40.95]Stop and wait a sec
[00:44.08]When you look at me like that, my darling, what did you expect?
[00:51.20]I'd probably still adore you with your hands around my neck
[00:57.82]Or I did last time I checked
[01:08.38]Not shy of a spark
[01:11.69]The knife twists at the thought that I should fall short of the mark
[01:18.73]Frightened by the bite, though it's no harsher than the bark
[01:25.40]The middle of adventure, such a perfect place to start
[01:34.72]I'm going back to 505
[01:38.68]If it's a seven-hour flight or a forty-five minute drive
[01:45.96]In my imagination, you're waiting, lying on your side
[01:52.58]With your hands between your thighs
[02:28.66]But I crumble completely when you cry
[02:33.87]It seems like once again you've had to greet me with goodbye
[02:40.67]I'm always just about to go and spoil a surprise
[02:47.25]Take my hands off of your eyes too soon
[02:56.50]Well, I'm going back to 505
[03:00.79]If it's a seven-hour flight or a forty-five minute drive
[03:08.04]In my imagination, you're waiting, lying on your side
[03:14.64]With your hands between your thighs, and a smile
